children: According to estimates from 21 analysts, Mercedes-Benz Group AG stock's average price target has fallen from €52.85 to €52.52, with forecasts ranging from €36 to €70 per share
Based on the Oct. 8 closing price, the updated target implies approximately 35% potential upside
Consensus rating remains at “Buy” across 25 covering analysts, with 12 Buys, 9 Holds and 4 Sells
